games.name: Steel Titans
games.desc:
Steel Titans is one of the most realistic and historically accurate tank games on Roblox with over 160 tanks to choose from!


Controls:
WASD- move
Left click- Fire
Right click- Scope view
123- Change selected ammo for primary gun
456- change selected ammo for secondary gun
Space- Fire secondary gun(s)
E- spot
Q- binoculars
Tab- view score menu
X- X-ray to view modules
C- Turret lock
V- change view
T- toggle special action

games.name: Anomaly Lockdown [UPDATE!]
games.desc:
Experience the ultimate round-based survival game inspired by RBreach, Minitoon's SCP Containment Breach, SCP: Secret Laboratory and many more.

Game is in a very early development stage, expect some bugs!

Game utilizes full Voice Chat Support: Communicate using Proximity Chat or use found Radios to talk to your team across the map!

Basic Controls:
Shift to sprint
E to interact with doors pick up items
Q to Open inventory
F3 to open votekick menu/mod call

Credit to ampersad for various reinforcement wave spawn music
Credit to Maximum_ADHD and The Stalker: Reborn for heavy inspiration on SCP-966
Console playability is only available to players with a mouse and keyboard.
